newsitem.title: PERU: Lima bolsa to extend trading hours from Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: Lima bolsa to extend trading hours from Nov 4.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange said Thursday it would extend its trading hours from November 4 in line with international markets.

A statement from the bolsa said it would from that date operate trading hours of 0900 to 1700 local time/1400 GMT to 2200 GMT between October and June, and hours of 0800 to 1600/1300 GMT to 2100 GMT between July and September.
The bolsa currently opens for trading between 0900 and 1300 local time/1400 GMT and 1800 GMT.
